import json
n=28
g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
for r in range(n):
 for c in range(n):
  if r%5==4 or c%5==4: g[r][c]=8
# Fill complete tiles along the seed-to-seed straight segments.
tracks={}
for bc in range(5): tracks[(1,bc)]=2
for br in range(1,4): tracks[(br,0)]=2
for br in range(5): tracks[(br,2)]=3
# Color crossings where both tracks pass.
for key in set([(1,bc) for bc in range(5)]) & set([(br,2) for br in range(5)]): tracks[key]=6
for (br,bc),color in tracks.items():
 for r in range(br*5,br*5+4):
  for c in range(bc*5,bc*5+4):g[r][c]=color
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))

import json
n=28
g=[[8 if r%5==4 or c%5==4 else 0 for c in range(n)] for r in range(n)]

  has3=(bc==2)
  col=6 if has2 and has3 else 2 if has2 else 3 if has3 else 0
  for r in range(br*5,min(br*5+4,n)):
   for c in range(bc*5,min(bc*5+4,n)):g[r][c]=col
assert len(g)==28 and all(len(row)==28 for row in g)
print(json.dumps(g,separators=(',',':')))
